Ability to work independently and as part of a production team.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.   About Company    Nezkot Pty Limited is an Australian precision engineering and advanced manufacturing company specialising in CNC machining and the production of high-quality precision components. Nezkot operates with advanced machining technology and a skilled team to deliver customised components, tooling, and manufacturing solutions to meet customer requirements.
